in_marathi.name: Avarsha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire or Wish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avarsha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Avarsha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ava’ which means ‘desire’ or ‘wish’ and ‘rsha’ which means ‘ruler’. In Hindu mythology, Avarsha is considered to be the goddess of desire, fertility, and prosperity. She is also believed to be the consort of Lord Indra, the king of the gods.
